faqs.question: How long does a turnkey construction project take?
faqs.answer: It generally ranges between 8 to 18 months depending on the project scope, site conditions, and municipal permits. A detailed schedule will be shared with you prior to signing.

faqs.question: How do you ensure occupational safety and quality on site?
faqs.answer: Our sites employ full-time OHS (Occupational Health & Safety) experts. Additionally, our processes are regularly inspected by independent auditing organizations and our own internal quality team.

faqs.question: How do you select materials and perform quality control?
faqs.answer: We only work with brands holding TSE, CE, and equivalent international standard certifications. Laboratory tests and visual inspections are carried out at every stage, from material arrival to final application.

mimari-tasarim.shortDescription: Modern and aesthetic architectural drawings, 3D modeling, and expert project consulting.
mimari-tasarim.intro: During our architectural design process, we address your lifestyle habits, site conditions, and local zoning codes as a cohesive unit. We produce clear, practical, and highly aesthetic design packages from initial concept to construction drawings.

features.title: Concept Design

features.title: Feasibility & Detailing

process.title: Brief & Analysis
process.description: Your project objectives, site survey details, and legal codes are evaluated together.

process.title: Schematic Concept
process.description: The design aesthetic is established through mass, facade, and floor plan options.

process.title: Project Design
process.description: Construction drawings, detailed sections, and final 3D visuals are completed.

process.title: Approval & Support
process.description: We provide technical support during municipal permitting and field execution.

faqs.question: What are the main stages of the design process?
faqs.answer: The process consists of basic phases: needs assessment (brief), concept development, 3D modeling/rendering, permit application documentation, and detailed construction drawings.

faqs.question: Do you offer 3D visualizations and virtual walk-throughs?
faqs.answer: Yes, we build near-reality models of our projects before construction. Upon request, we can also prepare a 3D virtual tour of the designed space.

faqs.question: How many revisions do we get during the design stage?
faqs.answer: We provide reasonable iterations during the concept phase until we reach mutual agreement. Once construction drawings start, we focus on technical details.

highlights: Structural risk assessment and process consulting

features.title: Renewal Management
features.description: We coordinate all steps, from risk applications to demolition and reconstruction.

features.description: We create clear, fair, and legally sound solutions for land shares and property allocation.

features.title: Earthquake Resilience
features.description: We build highly secure structures in strict compliance with current seismic codes.

process.title: Evaluation
process.description: Building integrity, site potential, and legal viability are examined.

process.title: Agreement
process.description: The business model and division of property shares are finalized with owners.

process.title: Demolition & Build
process.description: After safe demolition, the new structure rises according to the schedule.

process.title: Handover
process.description: Individual units are completed and keys are delivered to the owners.

faqs.question: How do we confirm if our building is officially classified as structurally compromised?
faqs.answer: Through partner laboratories licensed by the Ministry of Environment and Urbanization, core samples are taken from the concrete to prepare a formal Seismic Risk Report, officially starting the process.

faqs.question: How do government subsidies and rent assistance processes work?
faqs.answer: Our team handles the applications for all legal incentives, including state rent assistance, relocation support, and low-interest urban renewal loan applications once the risk status is approved.

faqs.question: How are properties divided in land-share agreements?
faqs.answer: We calculate properties fairly based on zoning limits, plot values, and permitted construction areas, presenting a clear distribution protocol to all property owners.

features.title: Cost Control

process.title: Monitoring
process.description: Progress is continuously audited using field reports and design checks.

process.title: Closeout
process.description: The project is finalized with document handovers, site testing, and post-project reviews.

faqs.question: What kind of cost savings does project management offer?
faqs.answer: Through detailed planning, material bulk purchasing, and efficient subcontractor selection, we achieve an average of 15% to 20% budget optimization while preventing scheduling delays.

faqs.question: How can we track the project's progress?
faqs.answer: You can follow every detail through our weekly and monthly progress reports, budget variance sheets, and updated timeline schedules.

faqs.question: What measures do you have against scheduling delays?
faqs.answer: All our contracts include subcontractor delay clauses. We use critical path method (CPM) analysis to detect delays before they occur and allocate secondary crews as needed.
